starterDescription: Small, useful datasets that can be published automatically into a new warehouse.

datasets.title: Presidential approval — daily average
datasets.description: Daily modeled approval, disapproval, and net approval for the current president.
datasets.attribution: SnoutCounter; underlying polls credited by pollster in the source data
datasets.notes: Use this for the headline trend chart. Show methodology and uncertainty; do not present an average as a direct survey result.

datasets.title: Presidential approval — individual polls
datasets.description: Poll-level presidential job approval observations used by the SnoutCounter model.
datasets.attribution: SnoutCounter and the named original pollsters
datasets.notes: Retain pollster, field dates, population, sample size, sponsor, and source URL. Poll copyrights and reuse terms may differ.

datasets.title: 2026 generic congressional ballot — daily average
datasets.description: Daily Democratic and Republican generic-ballot estimates for the 2026 midterm cycle.
datasets.attribution: SnoutCounter; underlying polls credited by pollster in the source data
datasets.notes: Useful as the second political trend dataset and for comparing model movement with presidential approval.

datasets.title: County population estimates, 2020–2025
datasets.description: Resident population totals and components of change for U.S. states and counties, Vintage 2025.
datasets.attribution: U.S. Census Bureau, Population Estimates Program
datasets.notes: Join to county boundaries with zero-padded STATE || COUNTY FIPS. Do not mix vintages in one time series.

datasets.title: U.S. state boundaries, 1:5m
datasets.description: Generalized 2025 Census cartographic state boundaries suitable for national web maps.
datasets.attribution: U.S. Census Bureau, 2025 Cartographic Boundary Files
datasets.notes: Use generalized boundaries for display, not surveying, routing, or precise area calculations.

datasets.title: U.S. county boundaries, 1:5m
datasets.description: Generalized 2025 Census county and county-equivalent boundaries for choropleth maps.
datasets.attribution: U.S. Census Bureau, 2025 Cartographic Boundary Files
datasets.notes: GEOID is the five-character county join key. Connecticut uses planning-region county equivalents.

datasets.title: ACS county profile, 2020–2024
datasets.description: County population, median household income, poverty, home value, age, education, race, housing, and internet-access indicators.
datasets.attribution: U.S. Census Bureau, 2020–2024 American Community Survey 5-Year Estimates
datasets.notes: Requires a Census API key in 2026. Store estimates and margins of error together; join on state + county FIPS.

datasets.title: CDC PLACES county health estimates, 2025
datasets.description: Forty modeled measures covering health outcomes, prevention, risk behavior, disability, status, and social needs.
datasets.attribution: CDC PLACES, Division of Population Health
datasets.notes: Model-based estimates are not suitable for evaluating a local intervention. Keep confidence limits and measure identifiers.

datasets.title: 2024 presidential precinct returns
datasets.description: Precinct-level 2024 U.S. presidential election returns with source and coverage metadata.
datasets.license: Check the Dataverse record before redistribution
datasets.attribution: MIT Election Data and Science Lab
datasets.notes: Large and revision-prone. Import after the state/county prototype and preserve the exact Dataverse DOI/version.

datasets.title: 2024 Election Administration and Voting Survey
datasets.description: Jurisdiction-level election administration, registration, turnout, mail voting, provisional voting, and polling-place data.
datasets.attribution: U.S. Election Assistance Commission, EAVS 2024 Version 2.0
datasets.notes: Download the CSV and codebook together. Several fields require codebook-derived labels.

datasets.title: County personal income and GDP
datasets.description: County personal income, per-capita income, population, and GDP time series.
datasets.attribution: U.S. Bureau of Economic Analysis, Regional Economic Accounts
datasets.notes: Use CAINC1 and CAGDP1. Preserve LineCode, unit, and GeoFIPS rather than pivoting everything into ambiguous columns.

datasets.title: County labor force and unemployment
datasets.description: Monthly and annual county labor force, employment, unemployment, and unemployment-rate series.
datasets.attribution: U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics, Local Area Unemployment Statistics
datasets.notes: BLS blocks generic automated downloads from some networks. Use its API or download archive and retain series metadata.
